property_summary: After any caller other than the current CEO attempts to call DrugDealer(), the call must revert and ceoAddress must remain unchanged; the buggy version still attempts to set ceoAddress to address(0) on revert, but the require catches it, so we must exercise the successful case where msg.sender == ceoAddress and observe that afterwards ceoAddress equals the caller, while the bug sets it to address(0).
change_summary: Replace ceoAddress assignment with msg.sender to address(0), causing ceoAddress to become zero.
